messages:
Maya (PMM): Quick ask — can we make a 'sales snack card' for late-stage deals that highlights secure deploy options (VPC / on-prem), SLA guarantees, and a webinar hook? Need something <30s sales pitch + routing rules for inbound.
Jordan (Growth): love it. want a 1-slide summary + 3-line email blurb and 2 CTA variants.
Sam (Sales): For late-stage, add "migration path" note: hosted -> dedicated -> private. Customers ask about migration costs.
Lena (Product): I'll give the bullet on SLAs: Dedicated: 99.95% SLA, burst capacity, private: custom SLAs + support. Also add a single benchmark stat: cold-start p50 per-token latency numbers.
Alex (Security): add KMS/HSM mention and SOC2 + audit logs. Also a line about network isolation and optional air-gapped install.
Maya (PMM): draft copy attempt:
"Secure Serving, Faster Time-to-Value — Redwood gives teams predictable inference with VPC and on‑prem options, SLA-backed capacity, and KMS-protected keys. Move from Hosted to Dedicated to Private with no API changes."
Jordan (Growth): short email blurb:
"Hey {{name}}, when serving at scale you shouldn't choose between speed and control. Redwood gives SLA-backed dedicated capacity, private deployments (VPC/on‑prem), and migration paths that keep your app stable. Join our webinar Apr 20 for a deploy checklist." 
Sam (Sales): CTA variants:
- "Request a deploy cost estimate"
- "Book a private demo (security focused)" 
Maya (PMM): Webinar hook ideas: "How top FinServ teams cut inference costs by 40% while keeping audit controls" or "Deploy modes decoded: choosing the right path for regulated apps" 
Lena (Product): Benchmark snippet to include: "Baseline: 8ms p50 token latency on L4-optimized models (dedicated) — batching + KV cache reduces cost by ~33% vs naive serving." 
Alex (Security): Routing rules for inbound leads: if lead indicates 'compliance' or 'gov' -> route to Sales + Solutions Eng + Security AE. If budget > $X or mentions 'SLA' -> route to AE. Use tag: 'late-stage-secure' 
Jordan (Growth): Slackify routing pseudo-rule for ops team:
```
if lead.tags contains ["compliance","audit","gov"] then team = [sales-secure, se, security]
else if lead.stage == "late-stage" and lead.budget >= 100000 then team = [enterprise-ae]
else team = [growth-nurture]
```
Maya (PMM): Any objections to "sales snack card" terminology? it's meant to be quick one-sided sheet for SDR->AE handoff. 
Sam (Sales): fine by me. Want a short migration cost line: "Typical upgrade from Hosted to Dedicated: 2-4 weeks, estimated infra delta provided by AE" 
Lena (Product): I'll drop final bullets into the Figma doc: https://figma.com/file/secure-deploy-snackcard (working link). 
Jordan (Growth): I'll produce 2 subject lines and 2 webinar CTAs by EOD. 
Maya (PMM): Great — I'll stitch the card + email blurb + routing rules into a single artifact and upload to sales enablement. Can someone add the exact SLA numbers and security certs to the card by EOD? 
Alex (Security): copied. I'll add SOC2, ISO27001, and KMS/HSM notes + audit log blurb before 5pm. :thumbsup:
LaunchBot: Webinar scheduled: "Secure Deploy Paths" Apr 20 10:00 AM PDT — registration link created. 
Sam (Sales): sweet. once it's done I'll brief AE team in Friday sync. :rocket:
